import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid1, grid2;
    static int[][] dist = new int[10][10];
    static boolean[][][][][] reach = new boolean[60][10][10][10][10];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean valid(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }
    static boolean digit(char c) {
        return c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) dist[i][j] = 1000;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && digit(grid1[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] == 1000) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        grid1 = new char[n][n];
        grid2 = new char[n][n];
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) grid1[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) grid2[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();

        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') { sx = i; sy = j; }

        bfs(sx, sy);

        // initialize reach[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!digit(grid1[i][j])) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (valid(ni, nj) && digit(grid1[ni][nj]))
                        reach[0][i][j][ni][nj] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // propagate reach
        for (int k = 0; k <= t - 2; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++)
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (!reach[k][i][j][l][m]) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                                int nl = l + dx[d], nm = m + dy[d];
                                if (valid(nl, nm) && digit(grid1[nl][nm])
                                        && dist[l][m] >= k + 2 && dist[nl][nm] >= k + 2)
                                    reach[k + 1][i][j][nl][nm] = true;
                            }
                        }
        }

        // collect digit cells
        List<int[]> cells = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (digit(grid1[i][j]))
                    cells.add(new int[]{i, j});

        int V = 2 * cells.size() + 2;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<int[]>> graph = new ArrayList<>(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) graph.add(new ArrayList<>());

        // add source/sink edges
        for (int idx = 0; idx < cells.size(); idx++) {
            int x = cells.get(idx)[0], y = cells.get(idx)[1];
            int c1 = grid1[x][y] - '0';
            graph.get(0).add(new int[]{idx + 1, c1});
            graph.get(idx + 1).add(new int[]{0, 0});

            int c2 = grid2[x][y] - '0';
            int sinkNode = cells.size() + 1 + idx;
            graph.get(sinkNode).add(new int[]{V - 1, c2});
            graph.get(V - 1).add(new int[]{sinkNode, 0});
        }

        // add edges between digit cells if reachable
        for (int i = 0; i < cells.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < cells.size(); j++) {
                boolean ok = false;
                int xi = cells.get(i)[0], yi = cells.get(i)[1];
                int xj = cells.get(j)[0], yj = cells.get(j)[1];
                for (int k = 0; k <= t - 1; k++) {
                    if (reach[k][xi][yi][xj][yj]) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) {
                    graph.get(i + 1).add(new int[]{cells.size() + 1 + j, 1000});
                    graph.get(cells.size() + 1 + j).add(new int[]{i + 1, 0});
                }
            }
        }

        // Edmonds-Karp max flow
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[V];
            int[] parent = new int[V];
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            visited[0] = true;
            q.add(0);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int[] e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (!visited[e[0]] && e[1] > 0) {
                        visited[e[0]] = true;
                        parent[e[0]] = u;
                        q.add(e[0]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[V - 1] == -1) break;

            int inc = 1000;
            for (int v = V - 1; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                for (int[] e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e[0] == v) inc = Math.min(inc, e[1]);
                }
            }

            for (int v = V - 1; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                for (int[] e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e[0] == v) e[1] -= inc;
                }
                for (int[] e : graph.get(v)) {
                    if (e[0] == u) e[1] += inc;
                }
            }
            flow += inc;
        }
        System.out.println(flow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
